name: Corning Falcon 351146 6 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning Falcon 6 well multiwell cell culture plate, clear crystal-grade polystyrene, flat-bottom round wells, low-evaporation lid, sterile (gamma irradiated). Cat# 351146 is the non-treated item, registered here; the same mould (one Corning technical data sheet covers all of them) is sold as 353046 (TC-treated, 1/tray), 353224 (TC-treated, 6/bag), 353934 (TC-treated, 10/tray), 353846 (Primaria) and 353502 (notched TC plate for inserts) - any of these can use this definition. Dimensions are from the Corning Life Sciences 'Customer Technical Data Sheet - Multiwell TC Plates - 6 Well', document LSR00001; rev 5 (2018) was read from the 353046 copy hosted by Dutscher (pdf.dutscher.com/doc/3/35/353/353046/353046_FTen.pdf) and rev 4 (2013) from the 351146 copy at web_reference; the two revisions carry identical numbers. Corning's own site links this sheet from the product page's Documents tab but refuses non-browser downloads, hence the distributor-hosted copy is cited. Units in meters. Plate (without lid) length D = 127.63 mm, width E = 85.47 mm, height F = 20.19 mm; height with lid on is 21.43 mm; the lid (127.20 x 85.14 x 10.03 mm) is not modeled. Well top internal diameter 35.71 mm, recorded in 'diameter' per the top-diameter convention; bottom internal diameter 35.00 mm; depth 17.65 mm; growth area 9.619 cm^2; center-to-center 39.24 mm (assumed equal in both directions, the sheet gives one value); bottom thickness 1.52 mm. Media working volume 2.5-3.0 mL. DERIVED: Corning does not publish the A1 well center position on this sheet. The offsets here place the 2x3 grid centered on the plate footprint: offset_from_left_edge = (127.63 - 2 x 39.24) / 2 = 24.575 mm, offset_from_top_edge = (85.47 - 39.24) / 2 = 23.115 mm. This is consistent with Corning's Costar 6 well drawing DWG00673 (24.76 / 23.16 mm at 39.12 mm pitch on a 127.76 x 85.47 mm footprint, i.e. also centered to within 0.1 mm) but has not been checked against a physical Falcon plate. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
